title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
tagline: Four brothers. Four pizzas. Zero leftovers.
about: Four mutant turtle brothers and their rat sensei take on the Foot Clan from the sewers of New York.
cue: Order the pizza when it gets delivered down the drain.
faces: Fresh-pressed Granny Smiths, lime juice, club soda, over ice.
Cola, lemon-lime or root beer, on crushed ice.
Half-pint carton of whole milk, ice cold.
A crime wave all week, and the only thing in this city that showed up on time was dinner. Almost.
Prices subject to change. No hockey masks at the counter. Cheese shredded by hand, no relation. Form 4‑1990.
Any door, any stoop, any fire escape. No address? Tell us the corner and we’ll find the grate.
Pick-up at the counter. Regulars come in all sizes.
Customer says: late pizza, smaller tip.
We deliver anywhere. Yes, even there.
Hand-tossed thin crust, red sauce, whole milk mozzarella. Slice 1.25.
Thin crust, red sauce, mozzarella, spicy salami cups crisped at the edges.
Four thin pies: pepperoni, mushroom, the works, and a cook’s choice.
A dozen pinwheels: dough, red sauce, pepperoni, mozzarella. Baked golden.
Six tied knots brushed with garlic butter, parsley and parm.
Aged cheddar, brie, gouda, crackers, grapes, honey on the brie.
Chocolate chip dough baked in a pie tin, chocolate drizzle, candy.
Shaved Italian ice, fresh lemon and sugar, in a paper cup.
For the driver. Down the grate is fine.

Even down a manhole.How to make it500g pizza dough150ml pizza sauce80g sliced pepperoni150g grated mozzarellaRoll the dough into a thin rectangle and spread with the sauce.Cover with the pepperoni and mozzarella, roll up tightly from the long side, slice into 12 rounds and place cut side up on a lined tray.Bake at 220°C until golden.Sensei's CheesesAged cheddar, brie, gouda, crackers, grapes, honey on the brie.Very wise. Very old school.How to make it150g aged cheddar150g brie150g gouda150g crackers500g grapes1 tbsp honeyTake the cheeses out of the fridge an hour before serving to come to room temperature.Arrange the aged cheddar, brie and gouda on a board with the crackers and grapes, and drizzle the honey over the brie just before it goes to the table.MainsBrothers BoxFour thin pies: pepperoni, mushroom, the works, and a cook's choice.You call the toppings.How to make it1kg pizza dough400ml pizza sauce400g grated mozzarella150g pepperoni200g button mushrooms, sliced1 capsicum, slicedSlice the mushrooms and capsicum and divide the dough into 4 balls.Stretch each ball thin and top with sauce and mozzarella.Top one pizza with pepperoni, one with mushrooms, one with pepperoni, mushroom and capsicum, and one with whatever is left in the fridge.Bake each pizza on a preheated tray at the oven's highest setting until golden and bubbling, one or two at a time.SweetsCookie PizzaChocolate chip dough baked in a pie tin, chocolate drizzle, candy.Cut in wedges, like it should be.How to make it125g soft butter150g brown sugar1 egg200g plain flour1/2 tsp bicarb soda150g choc chips50g dark chocolate100g lolliesBeat the butter, sugar and egg together, then mix in the flour, bicarb and choc chips.Press into a greased pizza tray.Bake at 180°C until golden, then cool a little.Melt the chocolate, drizzle over the cookie, scatter with lollies and cut into wedges.DrinksGreen Apple FizzFresh-pressed Granny Smiths, lime juice, club soda, over ice.As seen on Channel 3.How to make it3 green apples2 limes200ml water800ml soda water2 cups iceBlend the apples with the lime juice and water, then strain.Divide over ice in 4 glasses and top with soda water.
